review.label: NON_EQUIVALENT
review.rationale: The original condition `if not evidence or any(item.profile_id != scope.profile.id for item in evidence):` performs a guard check that triggers when evidence is absent or contains items with mismatched profile IDs. Replacing this with `if False:` permanently disables the guard, meaning the conditional branch body will never execute regardless of the state of `evidence` or `scope.profile.id`. Any scenario where the original condition would have evaluated to `True` — such as empty evidence or profile ID mismatches — will now produce different observable behavior, as the guarded code path is permanently bypassed.
